|desc={{p|Umbreon}} is Greta's first known Pokémon. It was first seen at the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}'s opening ceremony alongside its Trainer. At Artisan Cave, it was used to battle Guile's army of stolen rental Pokémon. At the [[Battle Arena]], Greta used Umbreon as her second Pokémon. It managed to defeat [[Emerald's Dusclops]], but was defeated by his {{TP|Emerald|Sudowoodo}}.

Umbreon's known moves are {{m|Quick Attack}}, {{m|Double Team}}, {{m|Feint Attack}}, and {{m|Confuse Ray}}, and its Ability is {{a|Synchronize}}.}}

|desc={{p|Shedinja}} is Greta's second known Pokémon. It was first used at the [[Battle Arena]] to battle Emerald. There, it was the third Pokémon Greta used and battled Emerald's Sudowoodo. Despite its single hit point, Shedinja managed to defend against Sudowoodo's supereffective hits and fight back. Despite this, Sudowoodo survived Shedinja's attacks, allowing it to win via judgment.

Shedinja's known moves are {{m|Endure}} and {{m|Solar Beam}}, and its Ability is {{a|Wonder Guard}}.}}
